column7: claim
Relationships require personal privacy and freedom along with compassion.
Relationships repeatedly challenge beliefs and teach practical discernment.
Significant others are important mirrors through which beliefs and character develop.
May idealize partners and sacrifice own well-being for cherished relationship ideals.
Can be compassionate or generous without possessiveness.
Emotion regulation and decisiveness can conflict during relationship maturation.
Creative sensitivity combines with initiative and practical execution.
Potential talents in art, writing, languages, music, design, entrepreneurship, teaching.
Talents develop through sustained deliberate self-directed effort.
Especially motivated by work that is both technically challenging and personally meaningful.
Unconventional intellectual creativity and project novelty are strong motives.
Emotional steadiness from exalted Moon OR restless amplified desire from Rahu.
Powerful feelings can make romance and creative interests unusually compelling.
Public vocation develops through communicating expertise and creative/practical initiative.
Visibility, clients, working relationships and public-facing success likely significant.
Seeks pleasant or beautiful, supportive home/private environment.
Emotional security, comfort and connection central to private happiness.
Creative expression depends on secure emotional foundations.
Exalted yogakaraka Venus strengthens probability of vocational success or accomplishment.
Malavya yoga may produce refined aesthetics, property or enjoyable domestic conditions.
Discipline, commitment, responsibility and sustained effort are prominent.
Works toward long-term objectives and can improve malfunctioning systems.
Can sustain long-term goals OR abandon goals when they feel restrictive.
Serious patient study and research unusually characteristic.
May burden thinking with too much self-judgment or duty.
Balances action and patient judgment rather than constant impulse.
May exhibit measured courage OR oscillation between action and inhibition.
May withdraw from important relationships or networks because of restrictive commitments.
Skill acquired through repeated practice not effortless genius.
Willing to overcome problems with technical mastery and effort.
Strong need to test ideas for real-world usefulness and accountability.
May react to setbacks with inhibition or overly critical assessment.
Feels or can contain powerful emotional experiences.
May feel strong desire yet retain concern about moral consequences.
Emotional steadiness, receptivity and emotional security are emphasized.
Emotional experiences and creative desires can be amplified or restless.
Emotional sensitivity and maturity are central life-development themes.
Emotional independence and self-definition may coexist with needs for belonging.
Emotions combine imagination/expansion with constraint/responsibility.
Should contain emotional intensity ethically rather than act impulsively.
Should be compassionate without becoming self-erasing.
Should balance conviction and humility.
Solitude, withdrawal, contemplation and liberation are important concerns.
